# Routes

Every route of ContentKit's HTTP API (172). `contentkit.Engine.Routes` returns them under the host's prefix (`contentkit.Routes.Prefix`), each module a route group at its sub-path: kinds `/v1`, content `/v1`, contents `/v1`, upload `/v1/media/upload`, media `/v1/media`, codes `/v1/codes`, entities `/v1`, notifications `/v1/notifications`, versions `/v1`, offers `/v1`, discovery `/v1`, import `/v1`, publishing `/v1`. Request and response names are the schemas of [`api/openapi.json`](../../api/openapi.json), which also lists each route's query parameters and error codes.

**Tier** is what a route requires of its caller, enforced by ContentKit's gate over the host's `auth.Authenticator`, asked at most once per request: `open` (anyone; never authenticates), `public` (anonymous without a credential, else the one it proves; the host's resolver decides what it sees), `user` (a signed-in person, else 401 `unauthorized`, 403 `forbidden` for an application), `staff` (a person or an application holding the permission named, one of `access.Permissions()`, in the root scope of the host's auth, else 403 `forbidden`), `editor` (signed in, else 401 `unauthorized`; staff holding the permission named, or the target's own editors: its creators, a user-owned group's owner and holders of `{kind}:settings:manage` in its AuthKit scope, else 403 `forbidden`). A credential that fails is 401 `unauthorized` with the provider's `WWW-Authenticate` challenge on every tier but `open`; an auth outage is 503 `unavailable`.

Every error is `{"error", "code", …}`; the codes are at the end.

Anonymous readers can send `ContentKit-Reader-Preferences: {"filters":[{"group_id":"configured entity ID","visible":false}]}`. Reads that apply content filters merge these choices over the entrypoint defaults; authenticated accounts always use their saved settings. The header is limited to 8 KiB and 128 configured filters, rejects malformed values and duplicate or unknown IDs, and never grants access. Allow this header in the host's CORS policy. Browser clients should persist choices locally and prune removed filter IDs against `GET /v1/content-filters` without the header. After registration, `POST /v1/me/content-filters/initialize` adopts choices only for its matching `account_id` and only if no settings exist.

## The site's content model (`/v1`)

| Method | Path | Tier | Request | Response | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/v1/kinds` | open | — | 200 `ContentModel` | The site's content model: languages, tiers, content kinds, entity kinds, whether signals are recorded now and people's avatar preset. Cacheable for a minute. |

## Contents: content items, versions, catalog totals (`/v1`)

| Method | Path | Tier | Request | Response | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/v1/catalog/totals` | open | — | 200 `Totals` | Each kind's content, in all and per language: how many items an anonymous visitor's listing shows and opens, and how many each tier's holders open. The request's site scope applies. Cacheable for ten minutes. Query: `kinds`, `languages`. |
| GET | `/v1/contents/{id}` | public | — | 200 `Content` | A content item: its text in the viewer's language, live versions with their segments and access, groups and attributes; the body only to viewers who open a version, everyone else its description and the paywall decision. Editors see every version, every language and the moderation state. Query: `language`. |
| GET | `/v1/contents/{id}/versions/{vid}` | public | — | 200 `Version` | One version of a content item as the viewer sees it, with its segments and access decision; vid is its id or code. Query: `language`. |
| GET | `/v1/manage` | public | — | 200 `Content[]` | Content items to manage, newest first: drafts, scheduled, held and live ones; deleted ones on their own. root:content:write holders see all; others what they created, or an owner group's they edit. Query: `state`, `owner_group`, `q`, `language`, `limit`, `offset`. |
| GET | `/v1/manage/{kind}` | public | — | 200 `Content[]` | Content items to manage for one configured kind. Uses the same permissions and filters as the cross-kind /manage listing. Unknown kinds return not_found. Query: `state`, `owner_group`, `q`, `language`, `limit`, `offset`. |
| POST | `/v1/contents` | public | `ContentInput` | 201 `Content` | Creates a content item as a draft, with one version serving its text's languages when it names none. root:content:write holders, or an owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) in it. |
| PATCH | `/v1/contents/{id}` | public | `ContentPatch` | 200 `Content` | Edits a content item's listing, access, restrictions, attributes or creators. Creators, the owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) and root:content:write holders only. |
| DELETE | `/v1/contents/{id}` | public | — | 204 — | Deletes a content item: holders of its key still read it; one never sold is erased after the retention. Creators, the owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) and root:content:write holders only. |
| POST | `/v1/contents/{id}/restore` | public | — | 200 `Content` | Restores a deleted content item as it was. Creators, the owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) and root:content:write holders only. |
| POST | `/v1/contents/{id}/publish` | public | `PublishInput` | 200 `Content`<br>202 `Content` | Publishes a content item now, or schedules it for publish_at; 202 when the moderator holds it for review. Creators, the owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) and root:content:write holders only. |
| POST | `/v1/contents/{id}/unpublish` | public | — | 200 `Content` | Returns a published or scheduled content item to a draft. Creators, the owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) and root:content:write holders only. |
| PUT | `/v1/contents/{id}/text/{language}` | public | `CatalogText` | 200 `Content`<br>202 `Content` | Sets a content item's text in one language; 202 when the moderator holds a live item's edit (its last approved text stays public). Creators, the owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) and root:content:write holders only. |
| DELETE | `/v1/contents/{id}/text/{language}` | public | — | 200 `Content` | Removes a content item's text in one language. Creators, the owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) and root:content:write holders only. |
| PUT | `/v1/contents/{id}/creators` | public | `CreatorsInput` | 200 `Content` | Replaces a content item's creators. Creators, the owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) and root:content:write holders only. |
| POST | `/v1/contents/{id}/images` | public | `BodyImageInput` | 200 `InlineImage` | Takes a body image uploaded to one version (its private files): copies it into every other version, since versions share no files, and returns the reference to store in the body and a URL that shows it to the editor now. Creators, the owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) and root:content:write holders only. |
| POST | `/v1/contents/{id}/versions` | public | `VersionInput` | 201 `Version` | Adds a version after the others, a draft unless state says otherwise. Creators, the owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) and root:content:write holders only. |
| PUT | `/v1/contents/{id}/versions/order` | public | `OrderInput` | 200 `Content` | Orders a content item's versions: ids lists each version that is not deleted, first first. Creators, the owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) and root:content:write holders only. |
| PATCH | `/v1/contents/{id}/versions/{vid}` | public | `VersionInput` | 200 `Version` | Edits a version: languages, traits, label, state and schedule, access, attributes, text, segments and cover; a hidden version takes only its cover. Creators, the owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) and root:content:write holders only. |
| DELETE | `/v1/contents/{id}/versions/{vid}` | public | — | 204 — | Deletes a version; a content item keeps at least one. Creators, the owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) and root:content:write holders only. |
| PUT | `/v1/contents/{id}/versions/{vid}/segments` | public | `SegmentsInput` | 200 `Version` | Replaces a version's segments (chapters): ordered ranges, each released at its time. Creators, the owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) and root:content:write holders only. |

## Media uploads (`/v1/media/upload`)

| Method | Path | Tier | Request | Response | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/v1/media/upload/presign` | editor `root:content:write` | `PresignBody` | 200 `PresignReply` | Plans one upload after checking its path's rules and CanUpload: exists (commit directly), one PUT, or a multipart ticket. |
| POST | `/v1/media/upload/copy` | staff `root:import:write` | `CopyBody` | 200 `CopyReply` | Stages server-side copies of keys of the item's bucket outside ContentKit's namespaces, for one commit's puts (an importer's files). |
| POST | `/v1/media/upload/parts` | editor `root:content:write` | `PartsBody` | 200 `PartsReply` | Presigns multipart parts, each bound to its SHA-256. |
| POST | `/v1/media/upload/parts/list` | editor `root:content:write` | `TicketBody` | 200 `PartsReply` | The parts of a multipart upload that landed, to resume it. |
| POST | `/v1/media/upload/complete` | editor `root:content:write` | `TicketBody` | 200 `CompleteReply` | Assembles a multipart upload; blob is its staged name. |
| POST | `/v1/media/upload/abort` | editor `root:content:write` | `TicketBody` | 204 — | Abandons a multipart upload. |
| POST | `/v1/media/upload/commit` | editor `root:content:write` | `CommitBody` | 200 `CommitReply` | Applies ops to an item in one conditional write, then queues placement and processing; answers its uploads as an editor reads them. |
| GET | `/v1/media/upload/frame` | editor `root:content:write` | — | 200 `image/jpeg` | A JPEG still of a video upload, for the frame picker (UploadOptions.Frames). Query: `kind`, `id`, `version`, `path`, `t`, `w`. |

Staff holding root:entities:write write any entity; a signed-in person creates entities of user-owned kinds, as their owner and within the kind's max_per_owner, and the owner and holders of {kind}:settings:manage in its AuthKit scope edit names, text, attributes, cover, avatar and state. |
| DELETE | `/v1/entities/{id}` | editor `root:entities:write` | — | 200 `Group` | Marks a entity deleted, retires its AuthKit scope and hides its media; a user-owned entity's content is deleted with it, and restoring the entity (PATCH state active) brings that content back, and its media within the retention. Staff holding root:entities:write write any entity; a signed-in person creates entities of user-owned kinds, as their owner and within the kind's max_per_owner, and the owner and holders of {kind}:settings:manage in its AuthKit scope edit names, text, attributes, cover, avatar and state. |

## Content versions: reader plan, reader metadata, forks, downloads (`/v1`)

| Method | Path | Tier | Request | Response | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/v1/contents/{id}/versions/{version}/pages` | editor `root:content:write` | — | 200 `PageReview` | All retained page sources and their automatic or manual reader selection. Flags never block publication. |
| PATCH | `/v1/contents/{id}/versions/{version}/pages` | editor `root:content:write` | `PageReviewPatch` | 200 `PageReview` | Overrides page inclusion or reorders sources without renaming them. The current revision is required. |
| GET | `/v1/contents/{id}/versions/{version}/reader` | public | — | 200 `ReaderPlan`<br>202 `Pending` | A version's reader plan: its segments with their release state, the published item of each the viewer opens, the previews of a locked version, its playback item and reader metadata. 202 while it has no current publication. |
| PUT | `/v1/contents/{id}/versions/{version}/reader` | editor `root:content:write` | `ReaderMeta` | 204 — | Sets a version's reader metadata (editors and staff): anchors and audio cues on its pages and audio uploads. |
| POST | `/v1/contents/{id}/versions/{version}/fork` | user | `ForkBody` | 202 `Pending` | Fills a version without media from a sibling (editors): its uploads with their outputs, reader metadata and optionally its audio and segments, in a durable job. |
| GET | `/v1/contents/{id}/versions/{version}/download` | public | — | 200 `FileDownload`<br>202 `Pending` | Grants a version's download, what its kind's download serves (the original, a rendition, its pages as a zip), as the host's download policy allows and names, charged to the viewer's download quota: a FileDownload whose short-lived URL serves it as an attachment. The URL is the media host's, or, for a zip the policy marks for this viewer, the archive route's (relative to this one). Every segment released and the version open. 202 while it is prepared; 403 download_unavailable with the policy's reason and available_at; 409 no_download when the version has nothing to serve. |
| GET | `/v1/contents/{id}/versions/{version}/archive` | public | — | 200 `application/zip` | Streams the marked zip a download granted, under the name it granted: the version's pages, those the host's policy named marked for the viewer the ticket is for. 404 for an expired or foreign ticket. Query: `for`, `mark`, `name`, `ticket`. |

Records that fail are reported and the rest written; their rebuild jobs are queued. |

##  (`/v1`)

| Method | Path | Tier | Request | Response | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PUT | `/v1/publishing-operations/{id}` | public | `Request` | 200 `Operation` | Creates or resumes one immutable archive submission. id is a client-chosen UUID. Requires content write; creating missing taxonomy also requires group write. Tenant and app come from the verified request. Repeating identical input returns the same draft and renews expired upload instructions; changed input is a conflict. when_ready requires provider-supported durable authorization. |
| POST | `/v1/publishing-operations/{id}/complete` | public | `CompleteRequest` | 202 `Operation` | Completes the submission's declared upload and durably begins processing. The server owns its exact media commit; no caller-supplied content IDs or blob references are accepted. Repeats do not create another import. |
| GET | `/v1/publishing-operations/{id}` | public | — | 200 `Operation` | Reads an owned submission, its compact progress, asynchronous failure or final catalog path. This read never creates upload URLs or advances the operation. HTTP 200 does not imply successful publication. |

## Error codes

Clients branch on `code`; `error` is a message for people and may change.

| Code | Status | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `ambiguous_entity` | 409 | More than one entity matches the localized name or alias and scope; supply its ID. |
| `animation_not_allowed` | 422 | An animated image where the upload path refuses animation. |
| `animation_too_long` | 422 | The animation has more frames or seconds than the processor allows. |
| `animation_unsupported` | 415 | An AVIF or HEIF image sequence, which is decoded as one frame. |
| `checksum_mismatch` | 422 | The stored bytes differ from the declared SHA-256. |
| `comment_banned` | 403 | The actor is banned from commenting on this target; `ban` says the scope, the reason and when it ends. |
| `comment_too_long` | 422 | The comment is longer than the site allows; `details.max` is the limit in characters. |
| `comments_closed` | 403 | The target's comments are closed or hidden: existing ones may show, new ones and edits are refused. |
| `comments_locked` | 403 | The actor can't open the content (or the comment's version), so its comments take no writes from them; reads withhold them. |
| `conflict` | 409 | A concurrent change, a path or slug already taken, or an operation id already used for another commit. |
| `content_changed` | 409 | A publishing operation's content or version was edited after submission. |
| `download_unavailable` | 403 | The host's download policy refuses this download now: `reason` is its code, `available_at` when it opens if a matter of time. Nothing was charged. |
| `forbidden` | 403 | The actor may not do this. |
| `gone` | 410 | The content was removed. |
| `image_too_large` | 413 | The image has more pixels or frames than the processor decodes. |
| `image_too_small` | 422 | The edited image is narrower than its public preset's minimum width. |
| `image_unreadable` | 422 | The file is not a decodable image of its declared type. |
| `incomplete` | 409 | A multipart upload is missing parts. |
| `internal_error` | 500 | A server fault; the cause is in the server log. |
| `invalid_archive` | 422 | The publishing archive cannot produce the required supported pages. |
| `invalid_request` | 400 | The request is malformed: its body, a query parameter or a path value. |
| `limit_reached` | 409 | The owner already has as many groups of the kind as the site allows (max_per_owner). |
| `moderation_rejected` | 422 | The moderator refused the text; `error` says why. |
| `no_download` | 409 | The version has no file its kind's download serves: nothing uploaded, or its upload failed or was dropped. |
| `not_configured` | 501 | The capability needs a port the host did not configure; retrying does not help. |
| `not_found` | 404 | Nothing by that name, or nothing the actor may see. |
| `not_joinable` | 409 | The group has no free offer to join: it sells its membership, or nothing. |
| `not_uploaded` | 409 | A commit names an upload that has not landed; `blobs` lists the ones to upload again. |
| `operation_busy` | 409 | The publishing operation is preparing an upload or completing another request; retry. |
| `operation_conflict` | 409 | A publishing operation ID already names different immutable input. |
| `quota_exceeded` | 413 | The uploader's storage quota is used up. |
| `rate_limited` | 429 | Too many requests; retry after `retry_after` seconds (also the Retry-After header). |
| `source_conflict` | 409 | The external source already belongs to another publishing operation in this app. |
| `tenant_mismatch` | 500 | A host port answered with another tenant's data: a configuration fault. |
| `too_large` | 413 | The file is larger than its upload path allows; `details` has `size` and `max_bytes`. |
| `too_many_files` | 409 | The commit would put more files in an upload path, or the item, than allowed; `details.max` is the limit. |
| `type_not_allowed` | 415 | The file type is not allowed in the upload path; `details.allowed` lists the types. |
| `unauthorized` | 401 | The request needs a valid credential: it has none where the route needs one, or one that is expired, revoked or invalid. WWW-Authenticate says which. |
| `unavailable` | 503 | The host's auth, media storage or signal plane cannot be reached, or a commit's recovery is pending; retry. |
| `unknown_entity` | 400 | A publishing entity reference does not resolve in this app and entity creation is disabled. |
| `upgrade_required` | 503 | The media item was stored before v0.68 and is served once the host's media upgrade (contentkit_media_upgrade) has converted it. |
| `video_aspect_unsupported` | 422 | The video's display aspect is outside what its upload path accepts; `details` has `min_aspect` and `max_aspect` (width/height). |
| `video_over_budget` | 422 | The planned encode costs more than its upload path allows, or the source averages under a frame a second. |
| `video_too_large` | 422 | The video's frames are larger than its upload path allows. |
| `video_too_long` | 422 | The video or audio runs longer than its upload path allows. |
